pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark brown regions characterized by deeply indented, jagged perimeters with sharp pixel gradients. Geometric forms exhibit frequent acute-angled protrusions, creating a complex, non-smooth edge topology.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: System of light cream-colored pathways forming a continuous topological web. Intersections are primarily composed of tri-radiate nodes. Pathway thickness is narrow but maintains high continuity across the visible neck and torso regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a consistent low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the blurred background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small avian subject (oxpecker) is perched on the dorsal ridge at the junction of the neck and shoulder.
